plugin_cron.title: Scheduled jobs
plugin_cron.description: Free scheduled jobs: schedule built-in handlers with cron expressions, with retries, run-now and execution logs

rerun.started: "{{name}}" triggered — check the execution logs shortly

hints.cronExpr: min hour day month weekday; supports * , - /; evaluated in the server's local time zone
hints.params: Leave empty for defaults; must be a JSON object
hints.retryCount: How many times to retry after a failure (0-10), with exponential backoff
hints.timeoutSeconds: Per-attempt timeout in seconds (0-3600); empty or 0 uses the default of 5 minutes
hints.http: method (GET/POST), url, body, timeoutSec (max 30); public addresses only
hints.clean_logs: days (retention, default 30), targets (oper / login, default both)

errors.nameTooLong: Name must be at most 100 characters
errors.fields: Exactly 5 fields are required: min hour day month weekday
errors.paramsJson: Parameters must be a JSON object
errors.timeoutRange: The timeout must be between 0 and 3600 seconds

describe.monthly: On day {{day}} of every month at {{time}}

plugin_cron.runStarted: Started. Check the execution logs for the result
plugin_cron.deleteConfirm: Delete job "{{name}}"? Existing execution logs are kept.
plugin_cron.deleteBatchConfirm: Delete the {{count}} selected job(s)? A run already in progress is not interrupted, and existing execution logs are kept.
plugin_cron.deletedPartial: Deleted {{deleted}} of {{total}} job(s) (the rest may already be gone or belong to another tenant)

clean.title: Clean execution logs
clean.description: Deletes finished logs older than the selected period; running entries are never deleted.
